name: CaseColorHex
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "color-hex" (color). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering.
